verdict.rationale:
MotherDuck publishes a documented public API surface: official SDKs/drivers in multiple languages, a live OpenAPI spec (probe confirms HTTP 200 with 'openapi' key), and a documented SQL/MCP interface with both local and remote MCP servers verified working end-to-end at runtime. Machine-readable agent-skills and llms.txt manifests further support programmatic/AI-native access.

missing for 10: no independent third-party API client review beyond MotherDuck's own docs/probes.
